info.title: XCE_COMPOSER
info.description: Authenticated native XSTUDIO scene compilation and persistence. No image generation. Send exact project/asset IDs. Execution returns real images; do not rely on URL text.

get.summary: Discover projects, inventory/grades, saved compositions or research brief.

200.description: Authenticated result or verified image package

post.summary: Compile or retrieve actual execution images; explicitly save/edit/duplicate a composition or stage/approve intelligence. Read-only tokens cannot save.

asset_id.description: Exact saved record ID. execution + asset_id without configuration retrieves a LOCKED character CREF.

data.description: Existing scene/keyframe editor fields; omitted reference_sequence preserves the saved stack

reference_id.description: Existing image ID in this project

category.description: Use cref for locked character image retrieval; scene_batch for a scene handoff

asset_code.description: Exact saved asset code; supported for CREF resolve and execution

200.description: Authenticated result or verified image package

StudioConnector.description: Existing scoped, revocable XSTUDIO xst_ token. Never put the token in scene text or asset metadata.
